## Formatting — `cargo fmt` before every commit

Always run `cargo fmt --all` from the repo root before committing. It formats the whole
workspace; the CI and FULL-tier gate is `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, which fails on any drift.

## Delegation to sub-agents
